title_ru: Бюро находок и зонтик с уткой
description_ru: Том потерял в поезде смешной зонтик с уткой на ручке, а добрая сотрудница бюро находок помогает его вернуть.
text:
Tom: Excuse me. Is this the lost property office?
Mrs. Hall: Yes, it is. Come in. I am Mrs. Hall. What can I do for you?
Tom: I lost my umbrella. I think I left it on the train this morning.
Mrs. Hall: Oh dear. It is raining today, so many people come here. What colour is your umbrella?
Tom: It is yellow.
Mrs. Hall: Yellow. Hmm. Wait a minute. I look on the shelf for you.

Mrs. Hall: Here is a yellow umbrella. Is this one yours?
Tom: No, that is not mine. Mine is big, and it has a duck on the handle.
Mrs. Hall: A duck? Really?
Tom: Yes, a small blue duck. My sister gave it to me for my birthday. I love that umbrella.
Mrs. Hall: Ha! That is a funny umbrella for a grown man.
Tom: I know. Everybody laughs at it. But it is my duck.
Mrs. Hall: Okay, Mr. Duck. Let me check the big book. What time is your train?

Tom: I take the eight o'clock train from Oxford Road. I sit near the door.
Mrs. Hall: Eight o'clock, near the door. No umbrella in the book. But the train is still in the station. A man cleans it now. Wait here. I call him.
Tom: Thank you. You are very kind. I have a big meeting at ten, and I cannot go there in this rain without my umbrella.
Mrs. Hall: Hello? Dave? It is Mrs. Hall. Please look. Is there a yellow umbrella with a duck on your train? Near the door of coach four? ... Yes? ... You see it? Good, good. Please bring it to my office.
Tom: Is it there? Is it really there?
Mrs. Hall: Dave says yes. He sees a yellow umbrella under a seat. And yes, it has a duck.
Tom: Oh, that is wonderful news! I want to dance!

Mrs. Hall: Please don't dance in my office. The floor is wet. Sit down and have a cup of tea. Dave needs five minutes.
Tom: Thank you. You are very nice. Do you work here every day?
Mrs. Hall: Every day, for twelve years. I see a lot of strange things. Last week a woman came in and asked for her false teeth.
Tom: False teeth? On a train?
Mrs. Hall: On a train! She said she ate a sandwich and fell asleep. They are on the seat, in a small box.
Tom: And did you find them?
Mrs. Hall: Yes, we did. They were under her coat. She was very happy. She gave me a big kiss. I don't want a kiss, but I take the chocolates.
Tom: That is a good story. Now I feel better about my duck.

Dave: Hello, Mrs. Hall. I have something for you. A very silly umbrella.
Mrs. Hall: Thank you, Dave. Tom, is this your umbrella?
Tom: Yes! That is my duck! Hello, little friend. Where were you all day?
Dave: It is under a seat with an old newspaper and a sad banana.
Tom: A banana?
Dave: Don't worry. It is not on your umbrella. I check it.
Mrs. Hall: Now please write your name here. And your phone number. It is the rule.
Tom: Tom Baker. My number is oh-seven-seven, four-five-six, nine-one-two-three.
Mrs. Hall: Thank you, Mr. Baker. Here is your umbrella. Please keep it with you now.

Tom: I promise. I hold it very tight. Mrs. Hall, I have a question. Do you like chocolates?
Mrs. Hall: Everybody likes chocolates. Why?
Tom: Because I want to say thank you. There is a shop near the station. I buy a box for you.
Mrs. Hall: You don't need to do that. It is my job.
Tom: I know, but I want to. You help me, you make me laugh, and you give me tea.
Mrs. Hall: Well, I like the dark chocolate best. But only a small box, please. My doctor says I eat too much.
Tom: Dark chocolate, small box. I remember.

Dave: And I like the milk chocolate, by the way.
Tom: Ha ha! Okay, two boxes then. One dark and one milk.
Mrs. Hall: You are a very good man, Tom Baker, with a very strange umbrella.
Tom: Thank you. Goodbye, Mrs. Hall. Goodbye, Dave. I never forget my duck again.
Mrs. Hall: Don't say never. Everybody forgets things. That is why I have this job.
Tom: Then see you next time.
Mrs. Hall: Not too soon, please! And take care of the duck!

Tom: Oh, look. It stopped raining. What a day! Now I have my umbrella, and I don't need it.
Mrs. Hall: That is life, Mr. Baker. Walk to your meeting with the duck under your arm, and be happy.
Tom: I will. Quack, quack!
Dave: Please go now. People wait outside, and I think one of them has a green hat with a fish on it.

focus_sounds.tip_ru: Кончик языка слегка между зубами, воздух выдыхайте мягко; не заменяйте на «с» или «з».
Короткий звук между «а» и «э», рот полуоткрыт; не произносите «о».
Начните с «э» и плавно перейдите в «и»; это один слитный звук.
Задняя часть языка касается нёба, воздух идёт через нос; не добавляйте «г» в конце.

questions.question: What does Tom lose on the train?
What is special about Tom's umbrella?
questions.answer: It is yellow and has a small blue duck on the handle.

questions.question: What did the woman lose last week?
What does Tom promise to buy at the end?
questions.answer: Two boxes of chocolates, one dark and one milk.
